new_assets.brief_zh: 终南古墓第二间石室，室顶刻满人形刻痕与向外散射的细线，无文字；夜，烛光。
山后山坳红花丛，一道数丈长浓密花丛如屏风，树荫遮罩；日间树荫与夜间月光花影两种光态。
一只灰兔，体小，会快速钻进花丛。
林朝英石室专用落地烛台（燃），与寒玉床石室的 PRP_zhutai 不是同一件；张景 2026-11-11 要求单独立项

shots.end_state: 杨过站在烛台旁，手放下，小龙女仍仰头，墙面影子拉长。

Their hands meet through the flowers, palms pressed. Both have eyes closed, the collars of their robes loosened to the collarbone and shoulder line, covered below. Faint white vapor drifts upward. Dappled moonlight and dark blue shadows fill the background. The overall composition is balanced and still, with a sense of imminent disturbance.
